description: Cases for the print skill. They grade the output of scripts/print.py --dry-run (the lp command line, sheet count, whether pages are numbered, settings that could not be set). lpoptions fixtures: lpoptions-epson-ep30va.txt is the unedited output of `lpoptions -p <queue> -l` for a real EPSON EP-30VA on macOS (2026-10-08). ipp-generic and kgray-noduplex are made up (each says so in its comments). Expected sheet counts were worked out by hand as ceil(ceil(pages / pages per side) / (2 for duplex, 1 for one-sided)) x copies. The PDF samples have 7 pages (checked with pdfinfo). Run by tests/test-print.sh, from the tests directory.

cases.description: The defaults (black and white, duplex long edge, A4, plain paper) are picked from the EPSON's real keys, and 7 pages take 4 sheets
--color --simplex gives color and one-sided, and 7 pages take 7 sheets
--short-edge --copies 2 gives short-edge binding and 2 copies, 8 sheets
--2up puts 2 pages on a side. Duplex, 7 pages make 4 sides, so 2 sheets
A paper size the printer doesn't accept (A3) gets no -o and is reported under Could not set
On a printer with IPP keys (print-color-mode, sides, media, media-type) the defaults are picked (made-up fixture)
On a printer whose black and white is KGray and which has no duplex key, duplex is left out and reported, and sheets are counted one-sided (made-up fixture)
expect_contains: Could not set: duplex long edge

cases.description: --no-number on a PDF without numbers reports Page numbers: no and sends the source PDF as is
A PDF without numbers gets them added before printing (when qpdf and Chrome are there), and the numbered copy is sent
HTML is converted to PDF with page numbers (a 3-page sample, 2 sheets duplex)
An image counts as 1 page and gets no page number
